name: Agent Orchestration
summary: A 5-lesson course on agent orchestration. It covers building a team, assigning roles, planning workflows, evaluating outputs and shipping a working configuration bundle. Built for developers who want a reproducible, testable agent system, not just a set of prompts.

name: Dataset — Demand Report
